info.cls_ename: College of Information and Electrical Engineering

description.describe_ch: 電路是現代科技基本架構中不可或缺的一環。因此，本課程主要的內容在於介紹電路上的基本線性元件：電壓源、電流源、電阻、電容器、電感器、運算放大器等，以及電路定理與分析技巧。本課程電路分析的重點著重在直流電路分析上。
description.describe_eh: Electronic circuits are part of the basic fabric of modern technology. The main contents of this course are on the introduction of basic linear elements of the electronic circuits: voltage sources, current sources, resistors, capacitors, inductors and operational amplifiers. Circuit theorems and the technics of circuit analysis are also introduced. The circuit analysis is focused on the dc circuits in this course.

targets.describe_ch: 能理解並解釋各種電路定理及分析方法，同時可區別出他們的同異。
能應用電路定理與分析方法計算電路內各個元件的電壓及電流值。

iSoftwares.soft_memo:
版本：MATLAB 2025a
功能：MATLAB 是一種商業數學軟體。主要用於數值分析、數值計算、工程與繪圖、控制系統的設計與模擬、數位影像處理、數學訊號處理和財務與金融等領域。
iSoftwares.soft_memo_en:
Version: MATLAB 2025a
Function: MATLAB is a commercial mathematics software. It is mainly used in the fields of numerical analysis, numerical calculation, engineering and drawing, control system design and simulation, digital image processing, mathematical signal processing, and finance.

iSoftwares.soft_memo:
版本：NI Multisim 14.1
功能：Multisim™ 教學​版​是​電路​教學​應用軟體，​適用於​類比、​數位​與​電子​電力​的​課程​與​實驗。​它​可​以運用​視覺​化​方式​呈現​電路，​並​透過​模擬​儀器、​進​階​分析​與​上千​款​互動​式​元件​來​強化​理論​學習。
iSoftwares.soft_memo_en:
Version: NI Multisim 14.1
Function: Multisim™ Teaching Edition is a circuit teaching application software suitable for courses and experiments in analog, digital and electronic electricity. It presents circuits visually and enhances theoretical learning with analog instruments, advanced analysis, and thousands of interactive components.

一、請準時上下課，請勿遲到、早退、曠課。 
二、請假者，請按照逢甲大學請假規定請假。
三、上課時請專心聽講。
四、有問題者，可以隨時舉手發問。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
1. Please come to and from get out of class on time. Please do not be late, leave early, or be absent from class.
2. If you are requesting leave, please apply for leave in accordance with Feng Chia University’s leave regulations.
3. Please pay attention during class.
4. If you have any questions, you can raise your hand and ask at any time.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem:
一、請養成課後複習的好習慣。
二、若有任何問題，可以在請益時間到我的辦公室請益。
三、請善用資訊電機學院安排的課後輔導時間。
四、上課的投影片屬於教科書之延伸，受到智慧財產權法律的保障，所以不開放給各位同學下載。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem_en:
1. Please develop a good habit of reviewing after class.
2. If you have any questions, you can come to my office during consultation hours.
3. Please make good use of the after-school tutoring time arranged by the College of Information and Electrical Engineering.
4. The slides used in class are an extension of the textbook and are protected by intellectual property laws, so they are not available for download by students.
